priorityList: Summon your pet with Raise Dead before combat starts.
Maintain Virulent Plague on the target using Outbreak.
Cast Army of the Dead if you have at least 30 Runic Power.
Cast Dark Transformation while Army of the Dead is active or if Army's cooldown is longer than 30 seconds.
Cast Soul Reaper if the target is below 35% health.
If Festering Scythe is talented, cast Festering Strike to maintain the Festering Scythe buff and debuff.
Cast Putrefy if you are at max charges or if Dark Transformation has more than 15 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Death Coil if you have a Sudden Doom proc or if you have fewer than 2 Runes available to avoid capping resources.
Cast Festering Strike only if you have 0 stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready.
Cast Scourge Strike whenever you have 1 or more stacks of Lesser Ghoul Ready.
Cast Death Coil as your primary Runic Power spender and filler.
Use offensive racial abilities like Blood Fury or Berserking during Dark Transformation or when other major cooldowns are active.
Use combat potions and trinkets during Dark Transformation or when your pets are active for maximum burst.
